earth.name: Sunny Meadow
earth.subtitle: Home world

bloom.title: A Green Thread
bloom.text: Colour creeps back into the grass. Dr. Zonk says the soil remembers you.

bloom.title: The Meadow Stirs
bloom.text: Seeds you never planted push up overnight. The Vault is answering.

bloom.title: Full Bloom
bloom.text: The meadow is awake. One world down — and the sky is full of dark ones.

earth.intro: Everything grew from here once. Then the Bloom went quiet and the world forgot how. You still remember. Start small: a twig, a pebble, a berry.

projects.name: Clear the Path
talk: A visitor! Nobody has come up this path in years.
Tap the Meteor Heap for meteor chips. Two chips make a hot meteor. Two hot meteors clear the path!
projects.text: The path is clear! Behind the rubble: a heap of space rocks, a beeping snack cart and an old moonwater well.

projects.name: A Rock Border
talk: The space weeds walk into my garden like they own it. Rude.
Two rocks and a metal ingot for a border, dear.
projects.text: A tidy border. Nana is very pleased.

projects.name: Nana Luma's Snacks
talk: Snacks! One food tube and two snack cubes for the picnic.
The snacks are hereby confiscated. Mayoral privilege.
projects.text: First proper meal in years! Nana even washed the jars.

projects.name: Water for the Garden
talk: Tap the well: water drops make puddles, puddles make a canister.
projects.text: The garden perks up. ...Wait. What is that in the sky?

projects.name: Dr. Zonk's Workshop
talk: Blorp. Thank you for not screaming. Most planets scream.
I need a workshop: one Star Scrap, some metal plates and a shiny geode.
A REAL alien! Can I help? CAN I?
projects.text: Dr. Zonk's Lab hums to life. Recycle spare things there for 🧪 Science.

projects.name: Mend the Fences
talk: Citizens! The fence is broken. Also a moon goat ate my hat.
Two stacks of metal plates and a ration tray for the builder, please.
projects.text: The fence stands. The Meteor Heap gave its last metal and cools down now. A solar farm hums on the hill, a light stall opens and a fizz vent starts to bubble.

projects.name: Power Supper
talk: A supper under the stars! A solar panel for the lights, a ration tray and a water tank.
What is supper. I would like to learn about supper.
projects.text: Dr. Zonk had three trays. The old well has done its job.

projects.name: The Light Market
talk: Darling, a village without a light market is just houses in the dark.
A star lantern for the stall and a gem for the sign.
projects.text: The market glows! The space rocks are all used up, and buzzbots moved in for a while.

projects.name: Nectar Jelly
talk: Nectar jelly! A hex cell of nectar, quickly, before the buzzbots leave.
projects.text: Jelly for all. The snack cart is empty. In the woods, an eyeshroom log is blinking awake.

projects.name: Forest Fizz
talk: My mother's forest fizz: a bunch of eyeshrooms and a can of soda.
On my world, soda is a colour. Fascinating.
projects.text: Fizz for everyone. A suit loom hums for a little while. Sirra has ideas.

projects.name: Spacesuits for All
talk: Everyone is dressed like a scare-bot. No offence to the scare-bot.
A space helmet, a solar panel array and a soda for the tailor. I do the rest. I always do the rest.
projects.text: Suits for all. Then a delivery: a jet wreck, a toy chest, a hydro bed and a lens workbench. Busy days ahead!

projects.name: Jet Day
talk: A twin jetpack and a light string so it looks cool!
Jetpacks do not care about lights, Ember.
projects.text: Timmy flew all evening. The light stall and the fizz vent have given all they had. Then something small crashes behind the hill, blinking!

projects.name: The Little Visitors
talk: Blinkies! Babies. Far from home, like me.
Help one grow up: give it a toy robot and a jet boot. Can we keep it?!
projects.text: The little visitors are safe and very hungry.

projects.name: A Garden for Guests
talk: The space crows threaten civic order. I drafted a strongly worded letter.
Or two grow tubes, a power station and a spinning top for the Blinkies?
projects.text: The solar farm powers the last station and goes quiet.

projects.name: Stargazing Night
talk: Dr. Zonk says his home is up THERE. Behind the Moon!
A spyglass, a hydro tray and a twin jetpack. Nobody stargazes on an empty stomach.
projects.text: The Moon has tiny lights. "Friends," whispers Dr. Zonk. And in the woods: his ship. In pieces. Time to build a rocket! Down by the water: a slime pond, a cheese mill and a goo pit.

projects.name: The Cheese Shop
talk: Chef Gubbo, cheese master. Well, cheese master without a shop.
A grow tube, two slime puddles to age the cheese, and a spinning top to keep the Blinkies out of it.
projects.text: The cheese shop is open. Moon cheese for everyone!

projects.name: Goo Day
talk: Cheese but no bowls. Uncivilised, darling.
A cheese wheel, a hydro tray and a slime jar for the potters. There is moon goo by the river.
projects.text: The hydro bed is resting. Sirra ordered twelve vases.

projects.name: Fizz in the Garden
talk: Duchess Splatt. I have come a very long way for a proper fizz.
projects.text: Fizz under the stars. The Duchess leaves her cargo pod behind. On purpose.

projects.name: The Slime Pond
talk: A party at the slime pond! Slime deserves nice things.
projects.text: The slime frogs hold a party. Behind the crates: wobbling pet eggs, a busker bot and an old scrap hull.

projects.name: Toys for the Blinkies
projects.text: The Blinkies have a pet now. The busker bot plays one chord, over and over.

projects.name: The Space Parade
talk: A parade before the launch! A drum, a cheese stack and an orbit urn.
projects.text: Best parade ever. "Nearly there," says Dr. Zonk, patting a fin. The fin falls off.

projects.name: The Launch Pad
talk: A nose cone, a telescope, two slime jars to cool the engines, and a blob pup. It insists on coming.
Miss you? No. You are coming too.
projects.text: The rocket stands. Sunny Meadow is awake, and the Moon is waiting.

luna.name: Crater Camp
luna.subtitle: Luna

bloom.title: Dust Remembers
bloom.text: Glow spores drift up out of the regolith. Nothing has grown here in an age.

bloom.title: The Craters Sing
bloom.text: Light pools in the low places. Moonbeam says it sounds like a choir tuning up.

bloom.title: Luna Awake
bloom.text: The grey moon is silver now, and gardens ring every crater rim.

luna.intro: Luna went cold first — no air, no argument. But the Vault says a world only needs one living thing to start over. Find it.

projects.name: Light the Camp
talk: Oh, far out. Visitors. Sorry it is so dark, man — the lamps gave up years ago.
Two moon shards and a glow bulb and I can make a little ring of light. Vibes first, then everything else.
Kix stowed away in the cargo hold. Kix regrets nothing. Kix is cold.
projects.text: A little ring of glow around the tents. The dark is smaller already.

projects.name: Build a Dust Wall
talk: GREETINGS. I AM ROKK. I WAS THE BUTLER OF THIS CAMP. THE CAMP LEFT. I STAYED.
THE DUST STORMS KNOCK OVER THE TENTS. TWO REGOLITH BRICKS AND ONE ICE SHARD FOR MORTAR. PLEASE.
Kix could sell him a wall. Kix will not. Kix is being nice. Note it.
projects.text: WALL: STANDING. WIND: BLOCKED. ROKK: PROUD.

projects.name: The Crystal Garden
talk: Ah. Tourists. Mind the crystals, they are older than your planet and twice as interesting.
A prism core and a glow flower. I am building a garden. A tasteful one. You would not understand.
projects.text: Nix has arranged the crystals by colour, then by size, then by mood.

projects.name: Lanterns for the Dark Side
talk: THE FAR SIDE IS DARK FOR FOURTEEN DAYS AT A TIME. I DO NOT LIKE IT. I AM NOT AFRAID. I AM A ROBOT.
A MOON LANTERN AND A SILVER INGOT FOR THE HANDLE. FOR NO REASON. NOT FEAR.
projects.text: Rokk walks the far side at night now. Humming. Rokk does not hum. Rokk is humming.

projects.name: Catch a Comet
talk: A comet passes every night at nine, man. Like clockwork. Like a really cold friend.
Catch me its core and a ball of clear ice. Comets carry seeds, you know. Old ones.
Blorp. She is right. I checked. I hate it when the hippie is right.
projects.text: The comet's ice was full of old seeds. Moonbeam planted every one.

projects.name: Moon Launch Pad
talk: Kix has a business proposal. A launch pad. Kix builds, you pay, everybody flies.
Moon brick, moon star, one beacon so the pilot does not miss. Kix missed once. Long story.
There is a fire planet in range. Ember Hollow. Bring a towel. And a fire extinguisher.
projects.text: Beep! Pad ready! Kix tested it. Kix only exploded a little. Ember Hollow is in range now!

projects.name: A Home for the Pups
talk: Those bouncing things are moon pups. They chew crystals. MY crystals.
Give them a burrow somewhere far from my garden. A pup and a moth to keep them company.
projects.text: The pups have a burrow with a view. They bounce off the walls. Literally.

projects.name: The Rover Garage
talk: Kix found an old rover. Kix needs a garage. And a silver cup. For the grand opening.
THERE WILL BE NO GRAND OPENING.
There will be a SMALL grand opening.
projects.text: Six wheels, one drill, zero brakes. Kix loves it.

projects.name: Fuel the Heaters
talk: THE HEATERS RUN ON HELIUM. THE HELIUM RUNS OUT. EVERYONE IS COLD. MOSTLY ME. I AM METAL.
ONE GAS CANISTER AND ONE GLACIER BLOCK FOR THE COOLANT. THE IRONY IS NOT LOST ON ME.
projects.text: WARM. The whole crew slept through the night for the first time.

projects.name: Call Home
talk: The old dish still points at the sky. If it turns again, the camp can talk to everyone out there.
A radar dish, a pallasite for the tuner, and a glow tree for the vibes. Mostly the vibes.
Fine. I will admit it. I would like to call someone.
projects.text: The dish turns, the stars answer. Crater Camp is part of the sky again.

projects.name: The Fortune Tent
talk: I saw you coming! In my crystal ball! ...It was cracked, so you were in three pieces. Still.
A moon orb for a new ball and a prism heart to make it shine. Then I can see the future in ONE piece.
She is a fraud. A charming fraud. I want my fortune read.
projects.text: Madame Oops reads fortunes by the craters now. She is right about a third of the time. Nix says that is a record.

projects.name: The Algae Dome
talk: Everybody keeps arriving, man, and everybody is hungry. Visitors eat a LOT.
An algae dome to grow lunch in, and a fusion cell to keep it warm. Green food, good vibes.
I DO NOT EAT. I WILL SUPERVISE THE EATING.
projects.text: The dome glows green all night. There is algae soup for everyone. Rokk supervised every spoonful.

projects.name: Captain Glimmer's Moon Show
talk: MAGNIFICENT! A moon with NO show! I, Captain Glimmer, shall fix that at once.
A silver crown for the star (me), a comet heart for the finale, and a star critter for the audience to love. They will. They always do.
Kix sells the tickets. Kix has already sold the tickets.
projects.text: Standing ovation. The star critter took three bows. Glimmer took eleven.

projects.name: The Skyfall Museum
talk: All these visitors and nothing to look at but me. I am wonderful, but I am not enough.
A museum. A star geode, the old moon idol and the Fluffwing Queen's crown. Labels in my handwriting.
projects.text: The museum opened at dawn. The labels are very long. Everybody reads them anyway.

projects.name: The Deep Space Ear
talk: THE DISH HEARS THE OTHER WORLDS. NOW I WANT TO HEAR FURTHER. PAST THE EDGE OF THE MAP.
A DEEP SPACE ARRAY, AN ICE CASTLE TO KEEP IT COLD AND A MOON OUTPOST TO RUN IT. I WILL LISTEN. I AM GOOD AT LISTENING.
Blorp. If something out there says hello, I want to know first.
projects.text: Something out past the map is humming back. Rokk has started humming along again. He denies it.

cindra.name: Ember Hollow
cindra.subtitle: Cindra

bloom.title: Ash to Soil
bloom.text: Where the ash cooled, something soft is growing through it.

bloom.title: The Hollow Breathes
bloom.text: The vents sigh instead of roaring. Vulk has not seen that in his lifetime.

bloom.title: Cindra Reborn
bloom.text: Fire and garden, at the same time, without either winning. That is the whole trick.

cindra.intro: Cindra never went dormant — it went furious. The Bloom here did not die of cold. It burned. Ash is still soil, if you are patient.

projects.name: Rekindle the Forge
talk: HRM. A visitor. The forge has been cold for a hundred years. I have been angry for a hundred and one.
Two cinders and an ash mushroom. The forge eats, then it works. Like me.
projects.text: The forge breathes. Vulk pretends it was nothing. It was not nothing.

projects.name: New Tools
talk: The forge breathes. Now it needs tools. My old ones melted. My mood melted them.
An iron ingot and two obsidian shards. Sharp things. Good things.
projects.text: Hammers, tongs and one very large spoon. Vulk will not explain the spoon.

projects.name: The Glass Stall
talk: A REAL VISITOR! Do you want a glass bead? I make glass beads! I make TOO MANY glass beads!
Two beads and a big mushroom for the stall roof. Travellers will come. They will! Probably!
projects.text: Fizz sells beads to travellers who have not arrived yet. She says they will.

projects.name: Stew for Everyone
talk: Everyone here is grumpy because nobody has eaten. Vulk has not eaten since the volcano.
I had a rock in spring.
A jar of spice and a forge fire. STEW. The spiciest stew in the system.
projects.text: Very, very spicy. Nobody complained. Nobody could speak.

projects.name: The Bell Tower
talk: The vents roar at night. The old bell used to calm them. Do not ask how. I do not know.
A copper bell and a fire opal for the clapper. Then we sleep.
projects.text: The bell rings at sunset. The vents seem to quieten when it does.

projects.name: Heat-Proof Launch Pad
talk: A launch pad on a planet made of fire. Blorp. What could go wrong.
Iron anvil for the base. Obsidian mirror to throw the heat back. Bellows to cool the engines.
And a little flag! I will make the flag!
projects.text: It will not melt. Probably. Blorp. Tidal Shallows is next — pack a towel.

projects.name: Nests for the Salamanders
talk: The salamanders keep sleeping in Vulk's boots.
One salamander and an ember egg — they need a nest of their own!
projects.text: Tiny flames curled in warm stone. They follow Fizz everywhere now.

projects.name: The Basalt Hall
talk: Too many people now. Meetings. Opinions. I need a hall with thick walls.
A column stack and a copper cog for the door. A door that closes.
projects.text: A hall of stone columns, cool inside, warm outside. Meetings happen there now.

projects.name: Steam Power
talk: GREETINGS AGAIN. I FOLLOWED THE STEAM. STEAM IS POWER. POWER IS ORDER.
ONE BOILER AND TWO SULFUR CRYSTALS. THE SMELL IS UNFORTUNATE. THE PROGRESS IS NOT.
projects.text: PRESSURE: NOMINAL. HOLLOW: POWERED. ROKK: ALSO NOMINAL.

projects.name: The Lava Lights
talk: Last one! Lava lamps all over the hollow! Light that is warm when you touch it!
A big lava lamp, the great forge and a ruby shard to mark the spot. Then Cindra is ours again.
And then the oceans, friend. Tidal Shallows. You will need that towel after all.
projects.text: The hollow glows from end to end. Cindra is reborn.

projects.name: The Grub Brothers' Stall
talk: Deal! We heard there is a fire planet with customers. (He heard. I came anyway.)
A crate of fire gel to sell and a glass lily for the counter. Classy. Best stall on the planet. Only stall on the planet.
If they sell my spoon I will be angry.
projects.text: The stall sells everything twice: once by each brother. Fizz bought a bead from them. Her own bead.

projects.name: Dragonlet Daycare
talk: The fire critters had babies! Then the babies had OPINIONS!
A magma dragonlet to keep the little ones in line and a flame flyer to teach them to fly. Carefully! Mostly carefully!
projects.text: Tiny dragons asleep in warm sand. One of them sneezed and lit the stew. Everyone agreed it was better.

projects.name: The Clockwork Tower
talk: Kix has noticed nobody here is ever on time. Kix sees a business: TIME.
A copper clock and a steam engine to wind it. Kix will charge per minute. Small minutes.
I WILL KEEP THE TIME. FOR FREE. SORRY, KIX.
projects.text: The tower chimes every hour. Rokk is never late now. Kix is still a bit late. On purpose.

projects.name: The Great Fire Show
talk: MAGNIFICENT! A planet made of fireworks and NOBODY has done a show? Tragic. Leave it to me.
A sun core for the big bang, a brimstone heart for the smell, and a basalt gate to make my entrance. I always make an entrance.
Hrm. If it is loud, I am in.
projects.text: The sky over the hollow went gold, then red, then gold. Vulk clapped. Nobody had seen Vulk clap before.

projects.name: The Obsidian Citadel
talk: A hundred years ago we had a citadel. The volcano took it. I want it back. Bigger.
An obsidian throne, an iron bot to guard the gate and a ruby sceptre. Not for me. For whoever rules after. I am too grumpy to rule.
You would be a lovely king, Vulk!
projects.text: The citadel shines black and red over the hollow. The throne is empty. Vulk sits on the step next to it.

nerith.name: Tidal Shallows
nerith.subtitle: Nerith

bloom.title: The Water Clears
bloom.text: Silt settles. For the first time in centuries you can see the reef floor.

bloom.title: Reefs Return
bloom.text: Coral climbing the old ruins, fish following it up. Pearl will not stop humming.

bloom.title: Nerith Alive
bloom.text: A whole drowned world, breathing again through its gills.

nerith.intro: Nerith drowned slowly and politely. The cities are still down there under the shallows, full of shells and nothing else. Wake the reef and the rest follows.

projects.name: Clean the Beach
talk: Oh! Hello! Welcome to the Shallows! Mind the seaweed. And the other seaweed. It is all seaweed, sorry.
Two seashells and a bubble cluster and I can clear a path to the water. Then we can paddle!
projects.text: Sand you can actually walk on. Kelpa made a sandcastle. Then another. Then eleven.

projects.name: Replant the Reef
talk: The reef used to be every colour. Now it is mostly beige. Beige is not a reef colour.
Two coral sprigs to plant, and a seed pearl to keep them company. Corals get lonely.
projects.text: Little corals in neat rows. The first swimmers arrived an hour later.

projects.name: The Critter Market
talk: Harbourmaster Brine. Forty years on this pier. Thirty-nine of them grumpy.
No swimmers, no market. No market, no gossip. Two three-eye swimmers and some sea foam to keep them happy. Hop to it.
projects.text: The market bubbles with gossip. Exactly right.

projects.name: Crystal Stores
talk: Supplies go off down here. Everybody knows that. Except Kelpa, who keeps a swimmer in a jar "as a friend".
A crystal brick and a bubble jar for the store room. Please.
projects.text: Enough stores for the whole winter. Brine counted twice.

projects.name: Raise the Wreck
talk: There is an old saucer at the bottom of the bay. My first ship. I sank it. Long story. Short storm.
A porthole to patch her with and a pearl for luck. Pilots are superstitious. I am VERY superstitious.
projects.text: The old saucer floats again. Pearl swears it is the same one her grandmother flew.

projects.name: The Floating Launch Pad
talk: Blorp! The next world is up there. The only flat thing here is the water. So the launch pad will float.
Floating launch pads. In my day we launched things by throwing them.
A nautilus shell for the hull, a coral fan to steady it, a jelly bell for the lights.
projects.text: It bobs a bit. The rocket does not mind. Aurora Reach — the last world — is in range.

projects.name: Guard the Shellkins
talk: The shellkins are hatching! All at once! There are SO MANY of them!
A shellkin to show the others the way, and a tentacle pal to wave the sky critters off. Gently!
projects.text: Every shellkin made it to the water. Kelpa counted every single one, out loud.

projects.name: The Sub Dock
talk: Subs are coming in from the other worlds now. Rocket subs. Whatever those are.
A proper dock needs a tractor hook and a crystal pillar for a lighthouse. Do it right or do not do it.
projects.text: Subs come and go. Some of them from worlds you woke.

projects.name: Sea-Glass Lamps
talk: Darling, the Shallows are lovely by day, but by night? Pitch black. Unacceptable.
Sea-glass lamps and a strand of pearls to hang them on. Mood lighting. Everybody deserves mood lighting.
projects.text: The shallows glow green at night. The humming is louder now.

projects.name: Wake the Drowned City
talk: There is a city under the bay. My grandmother said so. She also said she was a mermaid queen, so.
The city is real. I have seen the domes at low tide.
Then let us wake it. A sunken idol, a coral palace and a star urchin — the old songs say that opens the gates.
projects.text: The domes break the surface, glittering. Nerith breathes again.

projects.name: Parcels by Sub
talk: Parcel! For... the bottom of the sea. Sign here. Any leg. Any tentacle.
I need a diving pod to deliver it and two glass floats to find my way back up. Six legs do not swim. I checked.
projects.text: Postie Blorb now delivers under water. Parcels arrive a bit damp. Nobody minds.

projects.name: The Big Aquarium
talk: Gerald is lonely! Gerald needs a BIG home with friends!
Gerald is a swimmer in a jar.
An aquarium and a glow octo so he has a night light. He gets scared. Like me.
projects.text: Gerald has two hundred friends now. Kelpa visits every morning. Gerald pretends not to notice.

projects.name: Madame Oops Reads the Tides
talk: The sea told me a secret! I did not understand it. It was very wet.
A tidal heart and a pearl orb. Pearls see everything. Hearts feel everything. I mostly guess.
Darling, she guessed my birthday. I am impressed and a little scared.
projects.text: The tides now arrive exactly when Oops says. Nobody knows if she predicts them or tells them.

projects.name: The Glider Races
talk: Darling, the gliders are faster than anything with an engine. Let us race them!
A star glider to lead the race, a shell horn to start it and a shell critter to judge. Slowly. Fairly.
projects.text: The star glider won. The shell critter announced the result two hours later. Everybody waited.

projects.name: The Crystal Lighthouse
talk: Ships from every world come here now. One more thing and the Shallows are a proper port.
A crystal lighthouse, a submarine to guide them in and a coral city for them to visit. Forty years I waited for this.
projects.text: The lighthouse sweeps the bay. Brine has stopped being grumpy. Thirty-nine years was enough.

vela.name: Aurora Reach
vela.subtitle: Vela

bloom.title: First Light
bloom.text: A thread of aurora, thin as a hair, stitched across the dark.

bloom.title: The Sky Weaves
bloom.text: Whole curtains of it now. Halo says the Vault is singing back.

bloom.title: The Bloom Returns
bloom.text: Every world you woke is visible from here, lit up like lamps in a long hallway. You did that.

vela.intro: The last place the Bloom was seen alive. There is no ground here — only cloud, light and whatever you can grow on them. This is where it ends, or begins again.

projects.name: Solid Ground
talk: Wheee! Oh — visitors! Careful, there is no ground. There is no ground ANYWHERE. Isn't it great?
A big cloud puff and some aurora silk to stitch it down, and you will have something to stand on.
projects.text: A cloud you can stand on. Zephyr has been jumping on it for an hour.

projects.name: Stitch the Sky
talk: Hello. I have been expecting you for three hundred years. You are slightly late.
The sky is torn. An aurora veil to mend it and two starlets to pin it in place.
projects.text: One stripe of colour across the dark. Halo keeps looking up.

projects.name: Cloud Jelly
talk: Chirrup! New faces! Did you hear about Zephyr? Fell off a cloud. TWICE. Anyway.
Cloud jelly floats off unless you hold it down. A jelly jar and a wind coil to keep it put.
projects.text: Wobbly jelly on every cloud. The cloud critters found it before anyone.

projects.name: Tune the Chimes
talk: The chimes stopped ringing when the Bloom left. Nobody has gossiped properly since. Tragic.
A set of chimes and a prism lens to tune them. Chirrup!
projects.text: The chimes play a tune nobody taught them. Halo says it is the Vault singing back.

projects.name: Nests on the Wind
talk: The sky birds are coming home! I told everyone first. Obviously.
A sky plume to line the nests and a star cluster to keep them warm at night.
projects.text: Nests on every cloud. The sky birds are home.

projects.name: The Drift Yards
talk: The islands drift apart and nobody visits anybody. Let us fix that!
A drift balloon, a wind vane to steer by, and a thundercloud for... honestly I just like thunderclouds.
projects.text: Balloons between the islands. Everyone can visit everyone now.

projects.name: A Den for the Star-Kits
talk: The star-kits are frightened. They were born after the Bloom left and have never seen it.
A star sprite to lead them and an aurora cloak to keep them warm. Then they will have a home.
projects.text: The little star-kits have a den of their own. They glow brighter when you visit.

projects.name: The Orbital Station
talk: Kix has found a business opportunity. Satellites! Every world talking to every world. Kix sells the phones.
Kix. That is just a network.
A comm satellite and a nebula jar for power. Kix will handle the rest. Kix always handles the rest.
projects.text: Every camp on every world can talk to every other. Kix has not stopped beeping.

projects.name: The Celestial Garden
talk: The last garden. The Bloom grew here first, they say. We will grow it again.
A pot of starflowers and a ringed planet to light them. Slowly. Gently.
projects.text: Flowers that glow, planets that spin, a garden in the sky.

projects.name: The Bloom Returns
talk: This is it. The very last piece of the Vault. Everything we carried, from the Meadow to here.
A jelly isle, a prism array and a drone to lift it into the light.
Blorp. I think I might cry. Do not tell Rokk.
projects.text: Five worlds, all lit. The Vault is empty and the galaxy is full. That was the whole idea.

projects.name: Sky Mail
talk: Parcel! For... a cloud. Which cloud? They all move. This is the worst route in the galaxy.
A balloon airship to carry the mail and a cargo drone for the tricky clouds. Then I can finally be on time. Once.
projects.text: Sky mail flies every morning. Postie Blorb has been on time twice. A record.

projects.name: The Grand Orrery
talk: I would like to see every world you woke, all at once, turning in the light.
An orrery and a nebula lamp to light it. Then we can watch them from here.
projects.text: Five little worlds turn in the lamp light. Halo watches the Meadow the longest.

projects.name: The Star-Kit Parade
talk: MAGNIFICENT! A sky full of star-kits and nobody has thought of a parade?!
A comet critter to lead it, a sky bell to ring it in and an orb garden to finish at. I will walk at the front. Obviously.
Chirrup! I already told everyone! Twice!
projects.text: The parade went around every island. The star-kits glowed brighter than Glimmer. He let them, this once.

projects.name: The Rainbow Bridge
talk: What if you could walk from cloud to cloud? Without falling? I fell twice today!
A rainbow bridge, and a storm eye to keep the wind calm while we cross it. Whee!
projects.text: A bridge of every colour from one end of the Reach to the other. Zephyr has crossed it forty times.

projects.name: The Gate to Everywhere
talk: Rokk heard a hum from past the edge of the map. So did Halo. So did I.
A star gate, a supernova to power it and a bottled galaxy to show it the way. Then we go and say hello.
Kix is packing. Kix has always been packing.
projects.text: The gate opens on a sky nobody has seen. Somewhere out there, something waves back. To be continued...
